plugins.name: Amazon Quick (quick2api)
plugins.description: Amazon Quick provider for CLIProxyAPI through browser OAuth (OIDC + PKCE). No Amazon Quick desktop app required. Exposes Quick's agent tiers as quick2api-quick-smart (Claude Opus 5.5, 1M context) / balanced / fast / advanced, with streaming and non-streaming Chat Completions, an embedded card-style console, and full provider isolation from other plugins.
plugins.author: sbpk2077207

zh-CN.description: 通过浏览器 OAuth（OIDC + PKCE）把 Amazon Quick 接入 CLIProxyAPI，无需安装 Amazon Quick 桌面端。把智能档暴露为 quick2api-quick-smart（Claude Opus 5.5，1M 上下文）/ balanced / fast / advanced，支持流式与非流式 Chat Completions，内置卡片式控制台，与同宿主其它插件 provider 完全隔离。
